45.09

Region: The World’s Edge and Beyond.

The Kobold Exodus

Connects to: 10.12, 13.24, 22.10, 27.12 and 46.10.

Overview

It is rare for [kobolds](/wiki/appendix-c-creatures/) to migrate in large numbers. That is why the kobold exodus here is so surprising. Along this bit of the World’s Edge, thousands of the creatures swarm up ropes, ladders, improvised pulley systems and even the rock of the Edge itself. While their fellows climb, other kobolds patrol the thick air on canvas wings. What they are fleeing or where they are going is unknown.

Connections

<span lang="EN-US" style="font-size:9.0pt;font-family:"CenturyGothic","sans-serif"; color:black;mso-themecolor:text1">-The migrating kobolds seem to be avoiding the Lost Lighthouse ([46.10](/wiki/46-10/)).</span>

-Hex 22.10 talks about the “darkness behind the stars.” Is that the same thing?

Hooks

-What is the cause of this kobold exodus? Where are they going? Where are the dragons that spawned them?
